name: Fire Profile Texture Mapping
aliases: Fire Profile Texture Mapping — Unit Fire Volume Creation
definition: A method to create a 3D cylindrical unit fire volume from a 2D artist-created texture, controlling color, shape, and intensity.
summary: Fire Profile Texture Mapping generates real-time volumetric fire by sweeping a 2D artist-created texture around the z-axis to form a cylindrical volume, distinguishing itself through radial symmetry and direct artistic control.
